series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_qc_note: The myth movement, and the batch that found its visual language: heat as a single contained line, never a fire. Nineteen frames into the observation sequence, the episode turns to the Valyrian claim that dragons were born of the Fourteen Flames, so the palette moves from grey ash to black rock and one dull ember seam. Eleven generations for ten frames. 0394 is the best landscape of the reproduction, four cones stacked in haze with emerald valleys between them; 0397 is the batch's argument, a horned head emerging out of the rock lit only by an ember rim, which is the myth rendered as an image rather than a statement. 0396 solves the animal problem entirely by showing only its wing shadow on a colonnade of basalt.
silhouette_note: 0398 pass 2 is the direct result of last week's lesson: the limb count is now an explicit constraint, not an assumption. Pass 1's limbs at the base resolved at 2x into three gripping feet and its neck had stretched into a swan curve, both hard canon failures. Stating STRICTLY FOUR LIMBS with exactly two hind legs and exactly two wings, plus negatives for a third leg, a fourth leg, arms and a serpentine neck, produced a correct animal. Resting and perched poses are the highest-risk poses for extra limbs because the tucked second leg is easily read as a third support.
letterbox_scan_note: Per-row content-box scan on all ten frames. Four carried strips and were cropped and resized back to 1376x768: 0394 and 0398 at rows 12-755, 0397 at rows 12-767 and 0395 at rows 0-756. The other six were full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 28mm low-angle up the throat of one of the Fourteen Flames: sheer layered black basalt and oxidised slag walls rising out of frame on both sides, the cleft narrowing into drifting grey haze, and at its floor one narrow seam of molten rock glowing dull orange-red in its channel. Thin dark grey smoke lifts off the cracks. A vertical cathedral of rock with a thin vein of heat at its base. Nothing bright, nothing white. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 40mm over-the-shoulder from a standing figure in dark hooded wool on a shelf at the fissure mouth: only the back of the hood and a shoulder in soft shadow, no face and deliberately anonymous. Past it the cleft drops away in layered ribs and grey haze to a single narrow dull orange seam far below, with thin smoke crossing frame. Contemplative rather than dramatic. Full-bleed.
scenes.on_screen_figures_note: One anonymous hooded figure seen from behind; not CHAR-VAL-002 and not identifiable.

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide atmospheric composition — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 28mm deep-focus across a vast vaulted cavern beneath a Flame: layered black basalt ribs and hanging slag stalactites, a floor of cracked cooled lava with several narrow branching channels of molten rock glowing dull orange-red, crusted dark at the edges. Thin smoke gathers under the ceiling where a few grey daylight shafts fall through fractures. Three layers of rock separated by haze. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1, and the best landscape of the episode. 24mm ultra-wide from a high ridge: four stratovolcanoes layered in atmospheric perspective, summits lost in low cloud, each trailing a long thin grey plume bending the same way in the wind. Emerald ash-fed valleys and dark cypress belts between them, black scree and obsidian on the near ridge, and one thin dull orange fissure at the base of the central cone. Nothing warm except that seam. Reframed rows 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 50mm at close range inside the fissure: a shoulder of black basalt filled with a cracked ledge of cooled lava, the crack glowing dull orange-red beneath a dark glassy skin, thin smoke seeping out and sliding up the rock face. In the lower right a basin of old ash holds rounded stones, a shard of black glass and a pale curl that could be bone. Heat as one contained line, never a fire. Reframed rows 0-756.

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 35mm lateral tracking along the cavern floor past a wall of tall natural hexagonal basalt columns, rain-wet with pale mineral crust in the joints. A narrow channel of molten rock runs at their base, crusted dark with broken lines of dull orange showing through. A huge wing-shaped shadow sweeps diagonally across the columns from something out of frame above — no body, no claw, no tail visible anywhere. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1, and the batch's myth frame. 65mm compressed into an alcove in the fissure wall, where a wild dragon's heavy head and thick short neck emerge out of the darkness. One dull orange ember seam in the cavity floor rims the brow, both swept-back horns and the line of the jaw; everything else dissolves into black rock. One dim brass-gold slit eye catches the light, turned away from the lens. A thin dark grey smoke filament curls past the snout. The animal appears to be born out of the stone itself. Reframed rows 12-767.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium cinematic subject focus — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 2. 50mm from a lower ledge: an adult perched on a black basalt pinnacle against flat pale grey cloud, tail curling round the far side and tapering to a point. Checked at 2x: STRICTLY FOUR LIMBS — two muscular taloned hind legs gripping the rock and two wings, with the near wrist-claw attached to the wing's leading edge as book canon requires; no third or fourth leg, no arms. Chest deep and plated, neck thick and ringed rather than serpentine. Pass 1 read as three gripping feet at the base and had a swan-curve neck. Reframed rows 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 35mm wide tableau at the foot of a Flame: black scree apron meeting emerald ash-fertilised pasture, a low basalt ridge broken by a fissure leaking thin dark grey smoke, and four wild dragons airborne at different heights and distances against the immense banded cone behind. Each flyer reads as a compact heavy headed animal, not a bristling speck. Dark cypress and black boulders give the foreground scale. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation geographic / scale reveal — Valyrian claim: dragons born directly from Fourteen Flames
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 24mm high reveal to close the movement: six stratovolcanoes sweeping in an arc from left foreground into haze at right, each trailing a thin grey plume that merges into one flat ceiling of cloud; emerald valleys and black flows between them, and the land flattening to a flat silver-grey sea at the right edge. One small dark winged shape crosses just above the near ridge, a few percent of frame. Cold, grey, enormous, indifferent — no warmth anywhere. Full-bleed.
